notes: Mirrors the upstream model team's frozen S7comm Stage 1 / Stage 2 raw feature contract (STAGE1_RAW_FEATURES in two-models-info/S7___/90_attack_type_mode_router_v2.py, transcribed as tests/fixtures/contracts/s7comm_stage1_raw_features_v1.json) feature-for-feature: same 16 names in the same order, no common tier. Every value is read AFTER the current event has been applied to the (sensor, uid) connection state, as upstream's builders do. missingPolicy: REQUIRED when the feature's source field is required for the record to be scored at all (a record whose direction cannot be resolved is rejected to the DLQ); DEFAULT_ZERO when the value is 0 until there is history to compute it from; SENTINEL for the two categorical codes, whose absence is itself a category carried as a documented negative code (see categoricalCodes). Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-24-s7comm-stage1-design.md.

s7_rosctr.encode: the record's ROSCTR code (0 <= n < 2^24); -1 when absent

s7_operation.encode: the record's S7 function code (0 <= n < 2^24); when absent, the upper-cased function_name mapped back through functionNames if it is one of them, else -2; -1 when both are absent

features.name: s7_outstanding_requests
features.formula: unmatched request PDU references after this event

features.name: s7_outstanding_mean_16
features.formula: mean of the last <=16 values of s7_outstanding_requests, this event's included

features.name: s7_response_match_rate_16
features.formula: matched / count over the last <=16 responses; 0 before any response

features.name: s7_same_function_run_length
features.formula: current run of requests carrying the same function code; 0 before any

features.name: s7_same_direction_run_length
features.formula: current run of events in the same direction

features.name: s7_request_ratio_16
features.formula: requests / count over the last <=16 events

features.name: s7_direction_change_rate_16
features.formula: mean of the last <=16 direction-change flags; the first event contributes 0

features.name: s7_function_change_rate_16
features.formula: mean of the last <=16 function-change flags of requests carrying a function code; 0 before any

features.name: s7_function_entropy_16
features.formula: Shannon entropy of the last <=16 request function codes / log2(max(2, min(16, n))); 0 for n <= 1

features.name: s7_function_transition_entropy_16
features.formula: Shannon entropy of the last <=16 (previous, current) request function transitions / log2(max(2, min(16, n))); 0 for n <= 1

features.name: s7_rosctr_change_rate_16
features.formula: mean of the last <=16 ROSCTR-change flags of events carrying a ROSCTR code; 0 before any

features.name: s7_pdu_reference_unique_ratio_32
features.formula: distinct / count over the last <=32 request PDU references; 0 before any request

features.name: is_request_direction
features.formula: 1 iff the destination port of this record is 102

features.name: s7_function_changed
features.formula: 1 iff this request's function code differs from the previous request's; 0 for responses

features.name: s7_operation
features.formula: S7 function code; -1 = __MISSING__, -2 = unseen function_name (see categoricalCodes)
